steps.name: Step 1 — Pike Hold
steps.cue: Feet on a bench or box, hands on the floor, walk the hands back until your hips stack over your shoulders. Arms locked, push the floor away, look at your hands. Hold and breathe, come down before the arms shake. GATE: 3 sets of 20s in one session → wall walk-ups.

steps.name: Step 2 — Wall Walk-Up
steps.cue: Push-up position with feet at the base of the wall, facing AWAY from it. Walk feet up the wall and hands in ONE HAND-LENGTH at a time, then walk down WITH CONTROL — never collapse out. 3-5 slow reps per set. LOG the hand-lengths in on your best rep — that number climbing is your progress. GATE: all 3 sets reaching 5+ in one session → the full chest-to-wall hold.

steps.name: Step 3 — Chest-to-Wall Hold
steps.cue: Same entry as the walk-up: push-up position with feet at the wall, facing away. Walk feet up and hands in until only your chest is a hand-width from the wall — upside down, you finish chest toward the wall. Push TALL through the shoulders, squeeze the glutes, ribs in, look between your hands. Walk down BEFORE the arms shake. GATE: 3 holds of 30s with calm breathing → toe pulls.

steps.name: Step 4 — Toe Pulls
steps.cue: From the chest-to-wall hold, shift your hips over your hands and pull your toes off the wall. Log your longest free balance in seconds each set. GATE: 5 sets with a 3s free balance → kick-ups on open floor.

steps.name: Step 5 — Kick-Up (open floor)
steps.cue: Learn the cartwheel bail-out FIRST. Kick up to a freestanding handstand away from the wall, log your longest hold in seconds. Top of the ladder — goal is a calm 10s.
